## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues where relevant.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. State any Linux, sandbox, model, or benchmark checks that remain
unverified, and any additional requirements for reproducing the change.

## Review

<!--
Add items from the general PR checklist and all applicable task-specific checklists here.
Use AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/prepare-pr/SKILL.md to find the relevant checklists.
Add only items not already covered below; answer overlapping items in the existing entry.
Provide outcomes and supporting evidence; reference answers already in Change or Validation.
-->

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the affected behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] Commands, defaults, and public interfaces are consistent.
- [ ] Shared logs and examples contain no credentials or private data.
- [ ] Documentation-only: links the issue where it was discussed with the core team.
